# `aitbc node chain start`

Start a new parallel chain instance.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc node chain start [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--chain-id` | text | — | yes | The Chain id. |
| `--chain-type` | choice | `micro` | no | Chain type |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc node chain start --chain-id <chain_id>
```
